summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Himalaya Shipping Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 20, 2026. The meeting covered routine matters: presentation of audited financial statements, setting the maximum number of directors at seven, authorizing the board to fill casual vacancies, re-election of five directors, re-appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers AS as auditors, and approval of directors' fees not exceeding US$400,000 for 2026. This is a standard AGM notification with no special-situation event such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no actionable deal terms or strategic shift.
